raw_posts.name: distribution.dev
raw_posts.tagline: Advertise to developers on many sites with one campaign
raw_posts.description: Anyone can build a product now, so the hard part is getting people to see it. distribution.dev is an ad network for developers, built by the publishers themselves: daily.dev and DEV (dev.to), together among the largest developer content platforms in the world. You set up one campaign and it runs on many developer sites at once, with ads made to fit in on each one.

raw_posts.name: Granular.Build
raw_posts.tagline: Put your AI agents to work in a visual workspace
raw_posts.description: Big ideas shouldn't require a dozen AI tools or a programming background. Granular brings your models, agents, files, and project context into one visual workspace. Give a boss agent your goal, let it coordinate specialists in parallel, and watch apps, designs, or videos take shape with live previews. Bring your own AI, use built-in terminals and plugins when you need them, and keep each project's memory and files in one place. Go from first plan to published result.

raw_posts.name: Viktor Code
raw_posts.tagline: Coding agents know your repo. Viktor knows your company.
raw_posts.description: Coding agents know your repository. Viktor knows your company: your customers, your metrics and the decisions behind the work. So you give him a business outcome, not a ticket. He splits it into the technical and the non-technical work. He opens pull requests on your GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repos and brings them back for your review. His projects belong to the whole team, in Slack, Teams or Discord. Anyone can code now. Free to start, with up to $100 in credits.

raw_posts.name: Clam AI
raw_posts.tagline: Your inbox, safely shared with AI agents
raw_posts.description: Your inbox is a master key: password resets, bank alerts and health reports all run through it. Clam lets AI agents work in your email without holding that key. You write the rules in plain English, like "Read travel email. Draft replies. Never send." Each agent sees and does only what its rules allow, and you see everything it tries. We start with Gmail. We are building the permission layer for MCP: one that understands what the data means and the context of every request.

raw_posts.name: SparrowDesk Phone Calls
raw_posts.tagline: Phone support in the same inbox as email, chat & WhatsApp
raw_posts.description: Phone support inside your helpdesk. SparrowDesk Phone Calls puts calls in the same inbox as email, chat and WhatsApp. Buy a number in 51 countries, route callers with a visual IVR or an AI agent, and answer from the browser. Every call is recorded, transcribed and handled like any other ticket. No per-seat voice fees: pay as you go from a prepaid Voice Wallet.

raw_posts.name: Claude Ship
raw_posts.tagline: Ship code as fast as you can write it
raw_posts.description: Ship code as fast as you can write it: Claude Ship reviews, fixes, and approves pull requests, taking each one from opened to ready to merge. Code Review posts verified findings on each PR. PR Steward (beta) fixes failing CI, conflicts, and review feedback, but never merges. Claude Approvals (beta) approves routine changes under your team's policy file and asks a human about the rest. Run /ship in Claude Code to push, open the PR, and hand it off. For Claude Team and Enterprise on GitHub.

raw_posts.name: frwrd.to
raw_posts.tagline: Your link in bio, sorted by your AI in one message
raw_posts.description: Send your AI assistant your current link in bio or your website. It keeps what matters, matches your brand and publishes the page in every language you need. Campaigns end on their own, and you can edit everything by hand too.

raw_posts.name: Kodak SlideTag
raw_posts.tagline: A 1935 film-slide E-Ink frame that tracks like an AirTag
raw_posts.description: Inspired by vintage Kodachrome slide mounts, Kodak SlideTag is a tiny photo display with a six-color E Ink screen you can update from your phone. It doubles as a tracker for Apple Find My or Google Find Hub and comes in $34.99 blind boxes.

raw_posts.name: tday.com
raw_posts.tagline: AI-recorded Screen Studio style editable demos
raw_posts.description: Most features ship without a demo video. A good one takes hours to script, record, retake, voice and edit. Ask for a demo in one line from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Your coding agent records your real app on your machine, localhost included, and tday adds the voice, cursor, zooms, captions and your brand. Edit any narration line, then use it in your launch, docs or changelog. Web, desktop, terminal, iPhone and Android apps. Your code never leaves your machine. Free for 5 saved demos.

raw_posts.name: Agenda Hero Magic Labs
raw_posts.tagline: Any schedule. Any layout. Any style.
